chunks: Al-Tawhid: Hamza al-Alawi, from Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Udhayna, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), regarding His words, Mighty and Majestic:
There is no private conversation of three but He is the fourth of them, nor of five but He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them wherever they are

He (the Imam) said: He is One. Unique in Essence. Distinct from His creation. That is how He described Himself. He encompasses everything in terms of supervision, awareness and power. Nothing escapes Him even the weight of a particle in the Heavens and in the Earth nor smaller than that or larger - in terms of awareness and knowledge not by (His) essence, for locations (space) are bounded, delimited by the four bounds, so if it was (that He was encompassing) by essence than that would necessarily imply containment.
ai.seo_question: How does God encompass all things without being contained by space?
ai.summary: This hadith from Al-Kulayni's tradition elucidates the Shia doctrine of divine omnipresence (al-Hulul or al-Ma'iyyah) by distinguishing between God's essence and His attributes. The Imam clarifies that God is 'with' creation not by essence (which would imply spatial containment within limited boundaries) but by His encompassing knowledge and power, a key distinction in resolving the paradox of the Infinite within the finite.

en.ammaar-muslim: 13. [13/349] al-Tawhid: Hamza al-Alawi from Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Ibn Udhayna from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام about His words Mighty and Majestic:

“there is no private conversation of three but He is the fourth of them, nor of five but He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them wherever they are” [58:7].

He (the Imam) said: He is One. Unique in Essence. Distinct from His creation. That is how He described Himself. He encompasses everything in terms of (His) supervision, awareness and power (over them). Nothing escapes Him even the weight of a particle in the Heavens and in the Earth nor smaller than that or larger - in terms of awareness and knowledge not by (His) essence, for locations (space) are bounded, delimited by the four bounds (left-side, right-side, in-front, behind), so if it was (that He was encompassing) by essence than that would necessarily imply containment (which is impossible for Him).
